risks: Published WP-41 entrypoint verification was baseline declaration evidence, not current authenticated runtime behavior; the inspected gateway is owner-only local pending approvals.
Rox2CanonicalResult uses a triad while normative responseSchema uses seven status strings and receiptId; common owner must supply precise mapping without losing queued/ambiguous/fence states.

RestoreSnapshot and ReplayOutbox are named API changes without detailed schemas in the inspected specification. Resolve real accepted ports with operations owners rather than fabricate current symbols or a new persistence layer.
Shared new command paths overlap foundation WP-04/06/51 and other packages. Independent whole-file creation would overwrite integration work; one owner must merge contributions.

Generic fixture text saying provider sandbox is not needed unless outbound contradicts any waiver for the integrated mail/calendar/media scenarios; those scenarios require real isolated providers and independent read-back.

Proposed UI markers are not verified selectors. UI implementation files are indirect and outside this preflight's allowed inspection; existing-surface owners must provide precise selectors/patches during integration.
WP-47 restore and WP-52 readiness are hidden operational gates; WP-46 is downstream of WP-41. Do not add circular waiting edges or silently waive restore/mobile-capability evidence.
Passing baseline docs/static fixtures/local approval persistence is not shared feature completeness; every acceptanceMatrix row remains missing until observed runtime proof.
Seeded controls must break domain invariants, not merely make infrastructure unavailable. Retain first failures, independent holdout and exact reproduction seed.
Root integration may change protocol files while this report is prepared; sourceReferences hashes scope validity and verifier must reject stale bytes instead of blessing a later revision.

Migration 41-domain-contract.sql is a proposed identifier. Recreating command_receipt/outbox/inbox or unconditional snapshot rollback after accepted writes would violate one-authority and retention constraints.
Evidence privacy must exclude raw email/body/transcript/token values even for failed assertions; use isolated private marker checks, hashes and credential references.
